|strategy=By [mailto:ecolson@ix.netcom.com Eric Olsen]<ref name="decipher-strategy">https://web.archive.org/web/20040811123219/http://www.decipher.com/starwars/cardlists/endor/dark/small/sergeanttarl.html</ref>

Well, this guy's stats seem pretty average for a unique trooper, however his gametext can be very worthwhile if [[Noble Sacrifice]] is popular in your area., But his other gametext can also be useful. His other gamtext is obvious when you build around it. If your Capturing Deck includes [[Spice Mines Of Kessel]] for a little retrieval, then he is a must.

Ability 2 characters are important in booster draft, so try not to let him slip by there either!

If you are capturing (e.g. [[Boba Fett]] and [[Hidden Weapons]]), combo Tarl with [[Imperial Arrest Order]]. This ups his forfeit value to 5, but the ability to get out a [[Cloud City: East Platform (Docking Bay){{!}}Docking Bay]] is a sneaky way to complete your Spice Mines. Deploy [[Kessel (Dark){{!}}Kessel]], get out the Spaceport [[Cloud City: East Platform (Docking Bay){{!}}Docking Bay]] and drop your [[Spice Mines Of Kessel]] Utinni Effect there. One more [[Cloud City: East Platform (Docking Bay){{!}}Docking Bay]] for the planet you are on and retrieval + 4 is well on it's way.

Combos:

If you can arrange the destiny, the capturing is well under way.

Why worry about the strain of capturing anyway? Start with a captive, use the Objective to get the [[Cloud City: East Platform (Docking Bay){{!}}Docking Bay]] at Cloud City, use the [[Imperial Arrest Order]] to get a Spaceport [[Cloud City: East Platform (Docking Bay){{!}}Docking Bay]] at [[Kessel (Dark){{!}}Kessel]], and retrieval is only a transit away!
